title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 08bad1503658… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 08bad1503658a73333a903e2aa8dc28a4f7cddc8eaa6779d2f16ac40128ec8b7 was observed three times on November 14, 2026, by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. The file is associated with attacker activity involving the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The malicious payload could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool delivered or staged during the attack. The attacker infrastructure was located in the Netherlands. This indicator can be used to detect and block the malicious file in affected environments.
